n.quote: Replication results: In the replication experiment, the average perceived benefit of intervention was 4.406 (sd = 1.416; n = 114) in the intervention condition, compared to 3.456 (sd = 1.739; n = 113) in the control condition. This difference of 0.949 (se = 0.210) was tested using an independent samples t-test with equal variances (t(225) = 4.511, p < 0.0001; n = 227). As a result, we can reject the null hypothesis of no difference in average perceived benefits of intervention in the intervention condition compared to the control condition. The standardized effect size (Cohen’s d) is d = 0.599 (95% CI [0.337, 0.860]).
